note: One entry per game. The card fields drive the /games/ gallery, the home page, the footer, the sitemap and llms.txt. A game with a `content` file also gets its own page at `slug`. `play` is the tool page that runs the game (its facts live in tools.json under the same id).

games.name: Doctrine
games.sizzle: Raise a general that learns how you command.
games.line: An army game where you set the orders and a small general watches how you do it. Draft your cohorts, give up to four orders, and watch the battle run on a navigation mesh. The general suggests your next doctrine from your own choices.
games.teaches: Each order is one operation on the army's store, and the list of orders you may give is read from that store, so you see why an order is greyed out.
games.powers: The army is a set of Pleroma stores from Phasor, the battle runs on a Tracer navigation mesh, the rounds are EvalApp pipelines, and the general is a habit table with a tiny HoloFormer from AlgFormer.
games.phone: Laid out for a phone screen: one column, 44 px tap targets.
